market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $70 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: Settlement dropping to $70 implies ~30% decline from current ~$100 within 2 months while Strait of Hormuz tensions persist. EIA's downside scenarios don't go this low for Q2. Highly unlikely without major shock and Hormuz resolution.
data_sources: CNBC WTI near $100 Apr 28 Hormuz tensions
